signed_rows.behavior: With LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY set, a run sends spans for the agent run, each model request and each tool call to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL (default https://cloud.langfuse.com) plus /api/public/otel/v1/traces, with the header Authorization: Basic base64(public:secret).
signed_rows.fails_when: no spans are exported, the endpoint or header is wrong, or the model-request or tool-call spans are missing

signed_rows.behavior: Tracing is optional: with no Langfuse keys and no OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT, no exporter is built and OpenTelemetry's SDK and exporter are not imported; with only an OTLP endpoint set, spans go to that endpoint.
signed_rows.fails_when: a run without the variables builds an exporter or imports OpenTelemetry's SDK or exporter, or a run with only the OTLP endpoint sends nothing

signed_rows.behavior: The shell tool's environment holds none of the Langfuse keys or OTLP headers, and spans are flushed when the run times out or fails.
signed_rows.fails_when: a Langfuse or OTEL variable reaches run_shell's environment, or spans of a timed-out run are never exported

signed_rows.behavior: A live, full-length audit run with Langfuse keys shows its whole trace in a Langfuse project, with input, output and usage on its model calls; the how-to's section 5 says how to turn tracing on and that traces hold what the agent read, and ADR 0017 has a correction.
signed_rows.fails_when: the live trace is missing spans or the generations lack input, output or usage, or the docs leave out how to turn it on or what it sends

resigns.reason: r2 said OpenTelemetry is not imported; PydanticAI itself loads the opentelemetry API package, so the row now checks the SDK and exporter, which the script controls.
